description: A provider-agnostic session protocol for an MCP-backed backlog: resume before pick, unblock the sprint before leaving it, a ready card before an action plan, action plan before code, status reports, review before done, human walls, and Radar-style card references in code and commits. Officium is the first adapter.

tools.name: card_refs
tools.description: Lists card references (card://KEY) in the code, counts them per card, and flags temporary references to closed cards.

softDeps.what: The jira-agentic-requirements-pipeline skill, to select the questions a card that is not ready needs and render them as a requestHuman draft
softDeps.fallback: Ask the questions of references/readiness.md by hand, and write the wall card from them.
